budget.note: Measured on a seeded fixture of the same SHAPE as a real busy symbol (one function with stored call rows across many files), not on a corpus census. The per-call location memo in src/lsp/rich_hover.ts is what this number is a verdict on: before it, the collector resolved one location per ROW, re-reading and re-mapping a file per row.

limitations: The fixture is a REAL seeded index (real schema, real files on disk, real hashes) but it is AUTHORED, not a corpus census: the ratio it reports is the ratio this fixture's shape produces, not a corpus-wide rate.
The ratios are measured against the six pinned symbols only; a symbol with no stored rows renders nothing, which is declared absence and is not counted as a gap.
The call-site differential classifies stored lines through src/intelligence/graph/line-address.ts, which is the declared owner; it does not re-derive the rule.
No editor leg: every measurement here is the server component over the wire-less path. The editor render of these same facts is §12.6 E5 scope.
